| Trend Classification | Relative Strength Index | Percent Change | Mann-Kendall Test |
|---|---|---|---|
| Very likely upward | RSI ≥ 90 | 99% lower CI > 0 | p ≤ 0.01, τ > 0 |
| Likely upward | 90> RSI ≥ 80 | 95% lower CI > 0 | 0.01 < p ≤ 0.05, τ > 0 |
| Upward | 80> RSI ≥ 70 | 90% lower CI > 0 | 0.05 < p ≤ 0.1, τ > 0 |
| No Trend | 70> RSI > 30 | all CIs intersect 0 | p > 0.1 |
| Downward | 30 ≥ RSI > 20 | 90% upper CI < 0 | 0.05 < p ≤ 0.1, τ < 0 |
| Likely downward | 20 ≥ RSI > 10 | 95% upper CI < 0 | 0.01 < p ≤ 0.05, τ < 0 |
| Very likely downward | 10 ≥ RSI | 99% upper CI < 0 | p ≤ 0.01, τ < 0 |
